jobs.title: Program Coordinator - San Jose, CA
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Program Coordinator, you will provide basic administrative and logistical support to the program team. This includes project documentation preparation, scheduling meetings and communication, coordinating with vendors and stakeholders, tracking project progress, and assisting with financial reconciliation.

This role is part of the Center of Excellence Team. The team is responsible for the management of programs from initiation through completion.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Schedule meetings and communication plans regarding programs amongst teams and stakeholders.
* Assist with contract administration and account governance. This includes attending meetings, preparing correspondence, and tracking deliverables.
* Enter program information and data into program management technology tools.
* Process documentation for program commitments. Obtain external quotes for processing. Coordinate change orders, change directives and contemplate change notices with vendors and stakeholders.
* Track program milestones, budgets, and resources. Prepare and distribute regular program status reports.
* Process invoices and expense reports. Assist with program financial administration and reconciliation.
* Assist the program closeout process including turnover documentation and financial reconciliation.
* Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems while having a limited opportunity to exercise discretion.
* Deliver own output by following defined procedures and processes under close supervision and guidance.

**What You’ll Need:**

* High School Diploma or GED with up to 2 years of job-related experience.
* Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
* Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
* Basic math skills. Ability to calculate simple figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups.

**Why CBRE?**

When you join CBRE, you become part of a global leader in commercial real estate and investment services that help businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact! Our collaborative environment is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service, and excellence — and we value the varied perspectives, backgrounds, and skills of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your full potential!

**Applicant AI Use Disclosure:**

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

These updates reflect our commitment to clarity, inclusivity, and a consistent candidate experience across all postings.

**Disclaimers**

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

**Our Values in Hiring**

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Program Coordinator position is $44,500 annually [or $21,40 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Program Coordinator position is $85,000 annually [or $40,86 per hour]. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  
  
**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

jobs.title: Product Manager, HR Systems and AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

This role is an opportunity to join Marvell's HR organization as a product and program contributor driving high-impact, global initiatives. As part of the HR Product & AI Enablement team, you will own delivery of HR technologies, processes, and employee experiences across the HR ecosystem, and you will bring AI-enabled approaches to how Human Resources work. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HRIS, People Services, Total Rewards, and other cross-functional HR groups to deliver scalable solutions that improve how employees and managers interact with HR products and services.

**What You Can Expect**

**1. HR Product Delivery**

* Own end-to-end delivery of assigned HR technology and process initiatives, including scope, requirements, timelines, and release plans, under the direction of the HR Product & AI Enablement lead.
* Write clear product requirements and user stories that guide HRIS and technical teams, and validate delivered functionality against them.
* Maintain and groom the backlog for assigned workstreams, recommending priorities based on impact, feasibility, and alignment with HR's digital strategy.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and success metrics for assigned initiatives, and report status to stakeholders and leadership.

**2. AI Enablement**

* Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to HR and Talent Acquisition workflows, documenting use cases, expected value, and feasibility.
* Build and maintain templates and guided workflows that help HR and TA teams use approved AI tools effectively.
* Support pilots of AI-enabled features in Workday and other HR platforms, measuring adoption and business outcomes.
* Partner with Legal, IT Security, and Privacy to develop and apply responsible-use guidelines for AI involving employee and candidate data.
* Stay current on AI capabilities and HR technology trends, and share practical recommendations with the team.

**3. Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for product-related questions from assigned HR partners.
* Provide regular updates to global stakeholders and gather feedback to ensure transparency and alignment.
* Escalate priority conflicts or misalignment to the lead, and help ensure product work supports broader HR and Talent Acquisition strategies.

**4. Risk & Issue Management**

* Identify risks across systems, processes, and timelines for assigned initiatives, and develop mitigation plans.
* Monitor risks through the product lifecycle, escalating material risks early, and troubleshoot issues with HRIS and technical teams to root cause.

**5. Systems Implementation & Integration**

* Define business requirements, goals, and success criteria for Workday ATS and related module enhancements, so the what and the why are clear before HRIS determines the how.
* Partner with HRIS to prioritize and sequence system changes, and make scope trade-offs when delivery constraints arise.
* Document data and process requirements for integrations with other HR systems, and confirm with HRIS that the integrated design meets the business need.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing with HR and TA stakeholders, validating delivered functionality against requirements and confirming it achieves the intended business outcome.

**6. Training, Change Management & Support**

* Develop training materials and deliver sessions for HR users on new tools, processes, and enhancements.
* Support rollout and stabilization of assigned initiatives, gathering adoption feedback and iterating as needed.

**What We're Looking For**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, Arts or related fields and 5-10 years of related professional experience. OR Master’s degree and/or PhD in Business, Science, Arts or related fields with 3-5 years of experience.
* 3+ years of experience in HR, Talent Acquisition, HR technology, or HR program/product roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering HR technology or process projects from requirements through rollout.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools, such as LLM-based assistants, and applying them to real work processes.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies, and the tools that support them.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills across global, cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage several concurrent workstreams with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working with data and reporting.
* Experience with system integrations, especially in Workday.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on Workday experience, including Workday ATS or recruiting modules.
* Experience developing AI-enabled workflows or automation in an HR, Talent Acquisition, or HR technology setting.

**Expected Base Pay Range (USD)**

110,140 - 165,000, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Trust & Safety (T&S) Fraud Risk Management organization protects Merchant Services (MS) from fraud and compliance-related losses by providing detection tooling and operating strategy. The Fraud Strategy team serves as the end-to-end operating partner for the MS business: managing fraud rules and loss prevention with business growth, and owning the full fraud lifecycle — onboarding strategy, monitoring, loss analysis, controls, and product launch governance — while embedding fraud considerations early in product design and execution.

As a Trust & Safety -Fraud Strategy Analyst-Senior Associate within the Fraud Strategy team, you will play a critical role in identifying and mitigating fraud risks, leveraging your analytical expertise to promote impactful strategies and deliver end-to-end solutions**.**

* Develop and maintain analytics to provide management with comprehensive insight into emerging fraud trends and account quality.

* Analyze key performance metrics and profitability drivers to deliver insights across the full account lifecycle.

* Gain a deep understanding of operational processes (e.g., manual underwriting, portfolio management, collections) to inform performance drivers.

* Conduct ad hoc analytics and participate in strategic projects representing the Embedded Finance and Solution organization.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support solution development and implementation.

* Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders to inform business decisions.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a quantitative field.

* Minimum 2 years of quantitative experience required in strategy, analytics, or related areas.

* Background in statistics, econometrics, or other quantitative disciplines.

* Advanced proficiency in SAS, SQL, and spreadsheet tools.

* Ability to query large datasets and transform raw data into actionable management information.

* Familiarity with analytic techniques relevant to embedded finance and solutions.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Excellent written and oral communication skills.

* Experience delivering recommendations to management.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Master's degree in a quantitative field or experience in Risk Management, Fraud Strategy, or analytics within financial services preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager, Amazon Publisher Cloud
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Publisher Cloud is a game-changing new service that operates at the intersection of advertising, signal collaboration, and cloud services. Built on AWS Clean Rooms, APC is the first and only service enabling advertisers to activate more efficient campaigns, powered by exclusive signal collaboration between leading publishers and Amazon Ads. In this role you will be a key contributor within an entrepreneurial team tackling some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in digital advertising.  
  
In this organization you’ll experience the benefits of working in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment, while leveraging the resources of Amazon.com, one of the world's leading companies. We are seeking a Strategic Account Manager to join the Amazon Publisher Cloud team to help build industry-leading solutions for publishers. In this role, you will have the opportunity to join Amazon’s quickly growing advertising business, own strategic relationships with large publishers, and drive strategy and adoption of our industry-leading publisher solutions. In this role you will be a key leader within an entrepreneurial team tackling some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in digital advertising.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage product activation and overall customer experience for strategic streaming TV publishers.

  

* Employ a consultative, customer obsessed, and long-term approach to build productive relationships with publishers.

  

* Successfully launch new publisher products and features, share publisher feedback, and guide program strategy.

  

* Analyze publisher signals and performance data and provide data-driven insights to improve our advertising programs.

  

* Train publishers on program tools and provide strategic guidance to publishers on Amazon Ads solutions.

  

* Define processes and workflows that help deliver amazing customer experiences.

  

* Develop solutions to address key operational challenges, customer pain points, and sources of friction.

  

* Translate publisher feedback into product requirements and collect customer intelligence to help guide the overall direction of the program.

  
About the team  
Amazon Publisher Services helps digital publishers around the world build and grow thriving businesses. We provide services and advanced technologies to web, mobile app and advanced TV publishers of all sizes, including many of comScore’s global top 100, to help them monetize their content with demand from multiple programmatic buyers. Our server-side header bidding solutions are fast and reliable across devices, handling billions of queries per day, delivering ads in milliseconds. The result is more profitable advertising for publishers and more relevant ads for customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Experience with annual brand and media planning
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business or a related field
* At least 2 years of work experience leading partnerships with streaming TV publishers or advertisers.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
* Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
* Experience managing large publishers and deep understanding of publisher challenges.
* Knowledge of data clean rooms, publisher ad tech, and the programmatic advertising space.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues with Product Management and Engineering.
* Customer-driven product thinking and ability to identify and prioritize product requests.
* Team player with strong persuasion skills.
* Proactive attitude with excellent project management, organizational, and analytical skills.

jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work. We’re a diverse collective of thinkers and doers, continuously reimagining our products and practices to help people do what they love in new ways. That innovation is inspired by a shared commitment to great work — and to each other. Because learning from the people here means we’re learning from the best. Retail Operations creates the tools and programs that empower our teams to provide, a one of a kind, only at Apple experience. We do this by obsessing over the employee and customer experience, and driving a global strategy that sets the bar. The Apple Store Experience & Programs team creates the tools and programs that empower our teams to provide a one of a kind, only at Apple experience. We do this by obsessing over the employee and customer experience, and driving a global strategy that sets the bar.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this role, you will lead the overarching Demo Strategy & Operations, driving our Northstar vision. As a Strategic Program Manager, you will serve as the principal cross-functional orchestrator connecting Product Marketing, Marcom, Engineering and cross-functional Retail partners. You will champion core experience design principles and you will turn visionary concepts into high-impact, store experiences across multiple product categories. Sitting at the intersection of retail strategy, interactive software design, and global store execution, this role shapes how millions of customers touch, explore, and fall in love with Apple products worldwide. Our ambition is to deliver one connected experience across every retail touchpoint. We build reusable, flexible experiences that seamlessly support both independent self-discovery and 1:1 employee interactions—empowering store team members with effective tools that eliminate customer dead-ends and move customers with confidence from discovery to purchase. You will own the overarching retail Plan of Record (POR) for interactive demos, establish program governance across concurrent New Product Introduction (NPI) moments, and architect multi-quarter roadmaps for confidential Special Projects. You excel at leading without authority, aligning Senior Director and Director stakeholders across marketing and engineering, anticipating critical path risks well in advance, and safeguarding experience craft at global scale.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 5+ years of progressive experience in Strategic Program Management, Experience Design Management, Product Strategy, or Management Consulting leading complex, multi-disciplinary consumer experience initiatives.
* Proven success aligning diverse cross-functional teams across Product Marketing, Software/Hardware Engineering, Creative, and Retail Store organizations.
* Demonstrated expertise establishing program governance, modular frameworks, and master roadmaps for high-visibility portfolios from concept through global rollout.
* Proven ability to build trusted partnerships, navigate competing priorities, and drive consensus at the Director+ levels.
* Exceptional ownership mindset with the ability to structure ambiguous briefs into actionable work streams, contingency plans, and clear decision paths.
* Proven ability to leverage quantitative interaction data and qualitative store insights to guide experience decisions and measure program effectiveness.
* BA/BS or equivalent experience; MBA preferred.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Connects the dots at the project, team, and organizational levels to drive alignment.
* Systems-level thinker who identifies interdependencies and develops solutions that address interconnected challenges.
* Strong understanding of technology and its role in shaping retail experiences, with awareness of emerging technologies.
* Deep passion for Apple’s product portfolio, software ecosystems (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS), and in-store customer touchpoints.

Our technology impacts the visual experience in video game development, film production, deep learning, space exploration, medicine, computational finance and automotive design. And we've only scratched the surface of what we can accomplish when we apply our technology to it.

We need a diligent, focused, creative professional who want to be part of the growing opportunity and organization. As a Lifecycle Operations Project Manager in the Business Operations team, you will play a crucial role in managing and optimizing the logistics processes for hardware components across various projects. Your expertise will ensure timely delivery and efficient coordination of supply chain activities, directly impacting the success of our brand new AI initiatives.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Collaborate with teams to map the business operations lifecycle, identifying key touchpoints, paths for critical issues, and responsible contacts for all involved.
* Serve as the primary point-of-contact for lifecycle blocking issues and Process Accountability. Rapidly coordinate and communicate with internal and external parties to resolve issues and maintain operational momentum.

* Collaborator Collaboration: Partner closely with allocation and demand planning teams, engineering, OEMs, sales, and RMA to ensure alignment on requirements, timelines, and responsibilities.
Reporting & Visibility: Collect, analyze, and present data-driven performance reports and dashboards for management and customers, proactively pointing out risk areas and improvement opportunities.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ overall years of experience, including 4+ years directly in process mapping, supply chain, RMA, logistics, or related program management (preferably with hardware, technology, or AI-related products).

* Strong written and verbal communication abilities for complex, cross-functional collaboration and executive reporting.
* Experience showcasing process documentation, handling customer concerns effectively, and crafting operational playbooks.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Sales Business Operations
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

As the **Sr. Program Manager, Sales Business Operations**, you will lead the facilitation of multiple workstreams related to daily operations, workforce and expense management, and sales performance and recognition programs. In this role, you will work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to support a wide variety of departmental initiatives of local, regional, and national scale. **Job Overview**

Elex Solutions builds the electrical infrastructure behind California's electrification push — commercial and multi-family solar, and EV charging. We're hiring a Project Manager / Site Superintendent to own projects including scheduling, crew, and the client relationship.

This is a hybrid desk-and-field role. You'll manage the numbers and the paperwork, and you'll be on site often enough to know exactly what's happening in the ground and on the roof. If you like owning a job from award through Permission To Operate (PTO) and closeout, this is that seat.

**What you'll do**

* Run multiple concurrent solar, storage, and EV charging projects across commercial and multi-family sites
* Own labor hour and material budgets, track cost-to-complete, and flag variances before they become write-offs
* Build and hold the schedule against GC-set milestones; coordinate with GCs, owners, property managers, EPCs, and trade partners
* Supervise field crews and subcontractors on site — layout, sequencing, quality, and safety
* Manage utility coordination and interconnection with PG&E and other AHJs: make-ready, service upgrades, submittals, inspections, PTO
* Keep field documentation current in our project systems and support prevailing wage compliance on public works jobs

**What you need**

* 3+ years managing or superintending electrical construction, with direct experience on **multi-family and commercial solar and EV charging installations**
* Working command of NEC plus Title 24 and CALGreen EV-ready requirements
* Proven track record running budgets and schedules on projects in the $100K–$2M+ range
* Experience with California utility interconnection and AHJ permitting
* Ability to read and coordinate electrical plans, single-lines, and submittals
* Strong communication with GCs, owners, and inspectors — you're the face of the job
* Valid California driver's license

**Nice to have**

* Prevailing wage / public works experience (certified payroll, DIR eCPR, apprentice ratios)
* OSHA 30, NFPA 70E, and EVITP certification

**Compensation & benefits**

* $100,000–$135,000 per year, depending on experience and certifications.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance contribution
* Sick Leave
* Paid time off
* 401(k) Company up to 4% match
* Company vehicle or vehicle allowance
* Performance Bonus

**Why Elex**

* **You’ll own the job.** We’re a small, growing contractor, so you won’t be one of 40 PMs at a national firm. You’ll run each project from award to closeout and work directly with the owner. Your calls on schedule, crews and money matter here.
* **The work is getting bigger.** We’re moving from smaller jobs into larger commercial and multi-family solar, storage and EV charging projects. We’re also building relationships with major general contractors. You’ll join early enough to help shape that division and grow with it.

* **Room to grow.** This role can lead to Senior PM, a leadership role in operations, or other. We’d rather promote someone who already knows our jobs than hire from outside.

* Root Cause Analysis and corrective Actions, FMEA
* Experience in working with MS Excel, MS PowerPoint & MS Word

jobs.title: New Product Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

**New Product Project Manager**
-------------------------------

Bring structure, urgency, and cross-functional coordination to new semiconductor product introductions. As a New Product Project Manager, you’ll guide assembly and test activities from design planning through design verification and production release, helping ensure new products move through manufacturing efficiently, meet quality expectations, and ship on schedule. You’ll partner closely with engineering, operations, materials, planning, customer service, and program management, with significant ownership and minimal supervision.

### **What you'll do**

* Plan and coordinate new-product assembly and test activities from design planning through production release.
* Develop build sequences, manufacturing schedules, milestones, and material requirements.
* Partner with engineering and program teams to ensure manufacturing requirements are accurately reflected in Material Requirements Planning systems.
* Coordinate with planners, operations, materials, and customer service to keep builds moving against commitments.
* Adjust schedules in response to design changes, material or labor constraints, backlogs, and other changing conditions.
* Identify schedule risks, expedite delayed activities, and coordinate mitigation plans.
* Track project status, milestones, schedule performance, risks, decisions, actions, and owners.
* Maintain accurate order, amendment, shipping, and project documentation.
* Help ensure products meet company quality standards and delivery commitments.

### **What you need**

* Strong project planning, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills - **required**
* Ability to manage changing priorities and work independently in a manufacturing environment - **required**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience - **required**
* At least 5 years of directly related experience and/or training - **required**
* Semiconductor processing and radio frequency/microwave design or manufacturing experience - **preferred**
* Experience with MIL-STD-883 and basic knowledge of ISO and/or AS9100 - **preferred**
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Kaizen; Project Management Professional certification - **preferred**
* Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project proficiency, plus ability to travel domestically/internationally approximately 10% - **required**

### **What we offer**

An opportunity to take ownership of technically complex new-product builds, collaborate across engineering and manufacturing disciplines, and directly influence schedule, quality, and successful production release.

### **What happens next**

Submit your application for consideration. Details regarding the interview stages and candidate communications should be added once the recruiting process is confirmed.

*U.S. citizenship and the ability to attain and maintain a government security clearance are required. An active government security clearance is preferred. The role must follow applicable import/export requirements.*

**Salary Range:**

$141,900.00-$189,200.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Jr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Jr. Project Manager / Project Site Administrator / Document Control / Office Engineer**

**Location:** San Francisco International Airport (SFO), San Francisco, CA  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Project-Based)  
**Work Schedule:** On-site minimum four (4) days per week  
**Industry:** Aviation Construction / Public Works Construction

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Jr. Project Manager** / **Project Site Administrator / Document Control / Office Engineer** to support a major construction project at San Francisco International Airport (SFO). This position will be responsible for project documentation management, compliance tracking, administrative coordination, and support of offsite warehouse, field, and project management teams.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience working on large-scale public works or government-funded construction projects and possess a strong understanding of construction documentation processes, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, pay applications, certified payroll reporting, and contract compliance requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Documentation & Controls**

* Maintain and manage project document control systems in accordance with contract requirements.
* Coordinate and track:
  + Requests for Information (RFIs)
  + Submittals and shop drawing reviews
  + Change Orders and Potential Change Orders (PCOs)
  + Meeting minutes and action item logs
  + Contract correspondence and transmittals
* Ensure timely distribution, tracking, and archival of project documentation.
* Maintain current drawing, specification, and revision logs.

**Contract Administration Support**

* Assist Project Managers and Superintendents with contract compliance and documentation requirements.
* Support preparation and tracking of monthly owner pay applications through the collection of required documents such as lien waivers, supporting invoices, and releases needed from subcontractors and/or suppliers.
* Verify completeness of required documentation prior to invoice processing.
* Monitor compliance with project specifications and contractual reporting requirements.
* Responsible for taking meeting minutes and distributing to team members.

**Public Works & Labor Compliance**

* Administer certified payroll documentation in accordance with California prevailing wage requirements.
* Coordinate payroll reporting and labor compliance tracking using LCPtracker or equivalent systems.
* Support audits and requests from labor compliance officers, funding agencies, and project stakeholders.
* Maintain records related to prevailing wage compliance and subcontractor reporting.

**SFO Site Administration**

* Coordinate badging, security clearance, and access requests in accordance with SFO requirements.
* Assist project personnel, subcontractors, and visitors with airport access procedures.
* Maintain records of security training, badging status, and site access documentation.
* Collect and distribute subcontractors’ site daily reports.
* Interface with airport administrative staff regarding project documentation and compliance requirements.

**Software & Reporting**

* Maintain project records using:
  + Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  + Bluebeam Revu
  + ProjectSight
  + Procore
* Generate project logs, status reports, document tracking reports, and compliance reports.
* Support project team meetings and reporting requirements.

**Warehouse Logistics & Material Documentation**

* Coordinate and maintain documentation related to project materials, equipment, and warehouse inventory supporting construction activities.
* Track material procurement, deliveries, receiving records, storage locations, and distribution to field crews.
* Maintain material status logs and reconcile delivery records against purchase orders, packing slips, and subcontractor requests.
* Coordinate documentation for off-site warehouse operations, including inventory tracking and material movement records.
* Track long-lead materials and critical equipment to support project schedules and installation milestones.
* Maintain chain-of-custody and accountability documentation for contractor-procured materials.
* Support project teams with material expediting reports, delivery schedules, warehouse inventory records, and shortage/damage reporting.
* Coordinate with procurement, field supervision, subcontractors, and warehouse personnel to ensure accurate and timely documentation of material logistics activities.
* Utilize project management platforms such as Procore and ProjectSight to maintain material tracking logs and warehouse documentation records.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in construction administration, document control, office engineering, or project coordination.
* Experience supporting commercial, infrastructure, aviation, transportation, or public works construction projects.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Construction submittal processes
  + Request for Information (RFI) workflows
  + Change Order administration
  + Project specifications and contract documents
  + Payment application and waiver documentation processes
* Experience with California public works and government-funded projects.
* Familiarity with California certified payroll requirements and prevailing wage compliance.
* Experience utilizing LCPtracker or similar labor compliance management systems.
* Experience with construction material management, warehouse logistics coordination, inventory tracking, and receiving documentation.
* Understanding of construction procurement workflows, material delivery coordination, and warehouse record management.
* Ability to maintain accurate material tracking logs and support project-level reporting for procurement and logistics activities.
* Must be able to pass a background check for badging at SFO.
* Proficiency with:
  + Microsoft Office Suite
  + Bluebeam Revu
  + Procore
  + ProjectSight

*

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**The future you want is within reach. Let’s build it together.**

At PCL Construction, Inc., part of the PCL Family of Companies (PCL), we don’t just build projects—we build opportunities, careers and communities. We are 100% employee-owned, every employee has a stake in our success, and that shared commitment drives how we work, grow and lead in the construction industry.

We’re a team of builders who care deeply about what we create and who we build it with. That includes you. We are not only investing in what’s next in construction, we are investing in what’s next for your career.

As a Project Manager for PCL Construction, Inc. in San Francisco, California, you’ll have the opportunity to lead water and wastewater projects from planning through closeout, with responsibility for safety, budget, schedule, quality, and overall project performance. We’re looking for an experienced construction professional with a strong water/wastewater background who can manage collaborative delivery projects, build strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders, oversee contracts and project financials, identify and manage risk, and work closely with project teams to drive successful outcomes.

To be considered for this position, candidates must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or visa transfers for this role.

Why Choose PCL?

Choose a career with rewards that matter. PCL’s total rewards are designed to support your growth, well-being and future success—because when you succeed, we all do.

Our offerings could include:

* Employee ownership opportunities that build long-term value
* Annual discretionary performance bonuses
* 401(k) with company match
* Industry-leading medical, dental and vision benefits
* Prescription drug coverage and telemedicine services
* Life, AD&D and disability insurance
* Paid parental leave and family care support
* HSA or FSA for healthcare, dependent care and transportation
* Mental health and wellness support, including Employee Assistance Programs
* Career growth pathways, leadership development and mentorship programs
* Access to world-class training through PCL’s College of Construction and professional development courses
* Ongoing opportunities to learn new skills, explore different roles and grow your career across sectors and regions

Here's how a Project Manager for PCL Construction, Inc. within Civil West contributes to our team:

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Providing overall contract administration, technical expertise, and support to the project.
* Developing and implementing the project safety plan and leading by example for health and safety practices and procedures.
* Ensuring the project is constructed as per design, budget, resources, quality, and schedule.
* Understanding client drivers and offers value engineering proposals for functionality, cost, and schedule benefit.
* Managing project performance and providing performance status reports for safety, cost forecast, and schedule.
* Negotiating and issuing subcontracts, revisions, major purchase orders and progress payments and monitoring their progress and schedule.
* Understanding and enforcing the contract and contract documents.
* Participating in overall project commissioning and closeout.
* Identifying and managing risk and opportunities on construction projects.
* Manage collaborative delivery projects.
* Monitoring progress of the design, including compliance issues, quality, general coordination, constructability, and timing of deliverables.
* Assisting the project team lead obtain a comprehensive design-management and design-quality plan and conduct periodic quality audits to ensure compliance.
* Keeping all parties informed of potential opportunities and challenges, and managing stakeholders’ expectations through appropriate forms of communication

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in engineering, construction management, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of progressive construction experience with leadership and mentoring preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing a strong safety culture by application of health, safety, and environment principles and legislation.
* In-depth knowledge of construction industry including building materials, construction specifications, methods and procedures, construction law and building codes, and safety and quality management practices.
* Strong leadership, planning, organizational, and time management skills including the ability to manage project budgets and schedules.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders and decision makers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, project management and scheduling software, with a strong aptitude for adopting new technology.

The estimated salary range for this role is **$148,000 - $182,500**, based on your experience and qualifications. Final compensation will be confirmed as part of a personalized offer.

**Your Work Has Purpose Here**

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.title: HR Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Position: **Human Resources Coordinator**  
Term: Full-time, hourly  
Pay: $30.00/hour + health insurance, paid time off, and other benefits  
Location: San Francisco, CA or Los Angeles, CA  
Reports To: Deputy Director, Human Resources  
Direct Reports: None  
Updated: November 3, 2026

**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION**  
Urban Alchemy hires individuals who were once incarcerated and trains them to transform people and places through love and respect. We provide services that heal communities challenged by the intersection of extreme poverty, mental illness, addiction, and homelessness. When individuals are suffering in our public spaces, Urban Alchemy offers solutions. When a neighborhood, street, or intersection earns a reputation as a place to avoid, we turn it around. Urban Alchemy staff, known as Practitioners, create a peaceful and supportive presence, helping our communities rebuild a sense of pride one person at a time. Urban Alchemy is a nonprofit organization founded in 2018. We quickly grew from a small program in San Francisco to a thriving social enterprise with over 1,000 staff. We currently operate in California, Alabama, Colorado, Georgia, New Mexico, and Oregon. Over 95% of Urban Alchemy employees, including leadership, experienced incarceration and/or homelessness. For more information visit our website.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Human Resources Coordinator plays a vital role in keeping our day-to-day HR operations running smoothly, accurately, and supportively. This position oversees core administrative workflows that touch every employee across Urban Alchemy: onboarding, I-9 compliance, background check reviews, employment verifications, wage garnishments, and child support withholding orders. Because these areas directly influence legal compliance and an employee's livelihood, the Coordinator ensures each process is completed thoroughly, accurately, and on schedule.

Success in this role relies on consistency, thoughtful organization, and dependable follow-through. We look for someone who manages their daily desk with structured care, keeping clear track of active requests, monitoring upcoming milestones, and seeing items through to completion.

Based in Urban Alchemy's San Francisco or Los Angeles offices and supporting all operational regions, the Coordinator works directly with Practitioners during the onboarding journey. Many of our team members are justice-impacted individuals who may be navigating digital platforms and online onboarding tools for the first time. This calls for genuine warmth, patience, and a helpful, welcoming approach. As one of the first touchpoints a Practitioner has with our HR team, the Coordinator sets an encouraging, positive tone for their experience with Urban Alchemy.

**POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

A Note on the Nature of This Work  
Even in a fast-paced, high-volume environment, the details matter. Timely compliance for garnishments and I-9s ensures our organization meets essential legal standards, while an accurate onboarding packet directly shapes a new hire's first paycheck and their first impression of our community.

The Coordinator manages their caseload with a clear, proactive approach: tracking open items, anticipating deadlines, and keeping communication open across teams. When questions or potential delays arise, they surface them early, document the process, and partner collaboratively to find solutions before timelines are impacted.

**Onboarding Administration**  

* Own the full onboarding workflow for all new hires across Urban Alchemy regions, from offer acceptance through completion of all required documentation
* Coordinate with new hire Practitioners to complete onboarding paperwork via Paycom, including assisting individuals who are new to email, smartphones, or digital platforms; this may include helping a new hire set up a personal email account from scratch so they can receive and complete their onboarding link
* Maintain onboarding accuracy and completion rates at a high standard; missing or incomplete documentation creates downstream compliance risk and payroll delays
* Communicate weekly with the training team to confirm which new hires have completed their onboarding documentation in Paycom and are cleared to attend the following week's New Employee Orientation (NEO), so trainers can prepare accordingly
* Communicate clearly and proactively with HR team members and Operations when onboarding issues arise
* Travel to other Urban Alchemy regions to support in-person onboarding when a new region is being established or when operationally required

**Pre-Employment Compliance: I-9 and Background Checks**  

* Manage I-9 form completion for all new hires in compliance with federal requirements, including timely completion, proper document review, and accurate recordkeeping
* Conduct regular audits of I-9 records to identify and remediate compliance gaps before they become violations
* Stay current on I-9 regulatory requirements and flag any changes that affect current processes
* Review background check results for all new hires, identify any disqualifying findings per Urban Alchemy policy, and escalate promptly so the appropriate HR leader can initiate the FCRA individualized assessment process
* Understand that background check review is not passive; the Coordinator is responsible for reading results carefully, recognizing what requires escalation, and moving quickly so the interactive process can begin without delay
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all background check outcomes and escalations

**Garnishment Processing**  

* Receive, review, and process all garnishment orders accurately and in compliance with applicable federal and state laws
* Process garnishment orders in Paycom using the garnishment feature, which applies the deduction directly to the employee's profile; the Coordinator is responsible for timely and accurate upload so deductions are applied correc

This role focuses on organizing project documentation, providing project management support, coordinating team deliverables, and facilitating communication between project participants. The position may include limited task management responsibilities and requires familiarity with project workflows, documentation standards, basic technical understanding, and project management principles. * **Location:** Oakland, CA / Hybrid (client services are provided in person; documentation can be completed remotely)
* **Schedule:** Full time, Monday–Friday
* **Pay:** $34.62 per hour

**Our Program: C-Change**

C-Change works with youth who are at risk of, or have been identified as, sexually exploited minors, helping them transform their lives. The program focuses on stabilization, reducing mental health symptoms, building self-efficacy and self-determination, creating community, and connecting youth to additional resources. Our specialized model includes mental health screening, advocacy, clinical case management, and psychotherapy for at-risk youth. We serve young people up to age 21 who live throughout the Bay Area.

**The Position**

The ICC will work mainly with youth and young adults in C-Change. The role was is also referred to as a Mental Health Care Coordinator.

You will be responsible for assessing clients and for developing, coordinating, carrying out, and overseeing intensive, community-based behavioral health care plans. Clients have moderate to high acuity and complex needs that may be behavioral, medical, developmental, and/or psychosocial.

Each youth is supported by a Child & Family Team (CFT) that you will assemble and lead. The team draws on family, natural supports such as friends, extended family, neighbors, and community members, and formal system partners such as child welfare, schools, and juvenile probation, all working together toward the youth's goals and toward lasting change. You will coordinate and facilitate regular CFT meetings and both monitor and contribute to the youth's progress.

Guided by the Integrated Core Practice Model, you will use clinical judgment and discretion, in partnership with the team, to evaluate strengths and needs, choose interventions, coordinate services across disciplines, manage crises, link clients to resources, build behavioral skills, and design individualized care strategies.

The work is varied. It involves interpreting clinical information, applying professional standards, and making clinically informed decisions. You'll provide services and attend agency meetings virtually (Zoom or phone), in the office, and in community settings such as our drop-in center, client homes, schools, and parks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Assessment and care plans:** Perform comprehensive biopsychosocial, behavioral health, risk, and functional assessments for clients with complex, high-acuity needs. Contribute to building, implementing, and tracking individualized care plans that use evidence-based and trauma-informed approaches. Assess clinical progress over time and change interventions as your ongoing assessment and professional judgment indicate.
* **CFT facilitation:** Set up, organize, and run CFT meetings regularly with youth, families, and their community partners. Facilitation training is provided.
* **Caseload and direct services:** Manage up to 19 clients, with 50% of your time (20 hours per week) spent providing behavioral health services to youth and families. This includes assessing strengths and needs, connecting youth to resources, supporting skill building, and providing crisis intervention and de-escalation, while producing high-quality documentation.
* **Crisis response:** Assess and respond to behavioral health crises, safety concerns, and urgent situations, both independently and alongside colleagues. Decide on appropriate interventions, escalation steps, mandated reporting, and emergency referrals using professional judgment.
* **Documentation and billing:** Write daily progress notes and complete other clinical documentation in line with WCC policies and procedures for EPSDT Medi-Cal and other billing requirements. You should know Medi-Cal reimbursement and billing procedures or be able to learn them.
* **Teamwork:** Collaborate with enthusiasm as a member of a multidisciplinary treatment team, helping youth and families set goals and move toward them.
* **Ethics and mission:** Meet all ethical and legal responsibilities, including those of a mandated reporter, and represent our mission and philosophy.

**What We're Looking For**

*Required:*

* At least 2 years of professional, direct work with children and/or families using a mental health framework, in behavioral health, care coordination, intensive case management, social services, healthcare coordination, or related clinical services.
* Demonstrated experience with adolescents/minors who have a dual diagnosis, high mental health needs, and/or have experienced child sexual exploitation (CSE).
* Experience and skill facilitating groups, trainings, or treatment teams.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Counseling, or a related field. Significant relevant professional experience in mental health or behavioral health services may be considered instead of a degree.
* A vehicle, current car insurance, and a clean California DMV record. Travel by car to meet clients is required, generally within 90 miles of the WCC office.
* Availability for evenings and occasional weekends as needed.

*Skills and qualities:*

* Strong crisis assessment and intervention skills, and sound professional judgment when situations are unclear or changing.
* Passion for working with foster youth, families, and young adults with complex trauma histories.
* Strong motivation to work within a team-based approach.
* Commitment to humility, comp

jobs.title: DESIGNER AND PROJECT COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM · $45 to $55 per hour**

Read this first. This role is in person at our Berkeley studio, five days a week, 8:30 to 5:30 with an hour for lunch. It is paid hourly. If that works for you, keep reading.

We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com. This seat is two jobs in one. You are the studio's Revit and visualization expert, producing the models, drawing sets, and images behind every project. You are also the coordinator who keeps project information moving so our Project Leads can lead. It is also the seat we promote from. Within your first year you will lead a small project of your own, such as a kitchen, a bath, or a backyard studio, with a Project Lead signing off at each gate.

**What you will do**

Design and production

* Build and maintain the Revit model for each project, from existing conditions through construction documents, under the direction of a Project Lead.
* Produce drawing sets that pass our written quality review the first time.
* Own the studio's Revit standards: templates, families, and the habits that keep models clean.
* Create the renderings and visualizations we use to present designs to clients.
* Contribute design work of your own: studies, options, and details.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

Coordination

* Keep the logs current every day: submittals, RFIs, client selections, and bid tracking.
* Assemble bid packages from our templates, send them to subcontractors, chase the responses, and file them where they belong.
* Take meeting notes, turn them into action items the same day, and follow up until each one is closed.
* Track orders and lead times so nothing lands late on site.
* Support permit submittals: forms, sheets, and the response to comments.
* Keep project files organized to our written standard.

**What the work is really like**

This seat is about 65 percent design and production and 35 percent coordination, and both parts count. One day you are deep in a model. The next you are sending the third email and updating a log. People who want only to design will resent the follow up. People who want only to coordinate will not keep up in Revit. We are looking for the person who likes both, and who wants to run a project of their own.

**Who this fits**

* You hold a degree in architecture.
* You have five or more years of production experience in Revit, and you are the person others ask when a model breaks.
* You produce client ready renderings in V-Ray and Enscape, and your portfolio shows it.
* You have a designer's eye and can develop an idea into a buildable detail.
* You are organized in a way other people can see: your files, your notes, your inbox.
* You communicate before you are asked. If something will be late, we hear it from you first.

**What you get**

* $45 to $55 per hour, with overtime paid.
* A defined path. You lead your first small project within your first year, and we review your progress toward Designer Builder, the next seat up, at twelve months, against written criteria.
* Daily exposure to both design and construction, in the same room as the people doing each.
* Written standards for nearly everything you will be asked to do.
* PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
* Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
* A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
* Employer subsidized healthcare benefits

**How to apply**

Email your resume and portfolio to careers@olczakgroup.com. The portfolio should include drawing sheets and renderings you produced yourself, with your role stated on each. Use the subject line "Designer and Project Coordinator" followed by your name, and tell us the earliest date you could start. In the body of the email, answer these two questions in 150 words or fewer each:

1.What is the most disorganized project or situation you have inherited, and what did you do first?

2.What is one system you built to keep track of things, and how do you know it works?

Applications without both answers will not be reviewed. Finalists complete a short paid Revit exercise.

Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

NVIDIA is an industry leader with groundbreaking developments in HPC, Artificial Intelligence, and accelerated computing. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens new universes to explore, enables outstanding creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions - from artificial intelligence to autonomous vehicles.

We are looking for a senior technical instructor and training developer with deep expertise in AI infrastructure, AI operations, and AI networking. In this role, you will lead the NVIDIA Certified Instructor (NCI) certification program - training, assessing, and qualifying Authorized Learning Partner (ALP) instructors to deliver NVIDIA courses independently. This role calls for a hands-on technical practitioner who is also an exceptional trainer and a credible evaluator of others. We invite you to stand at the intersection of technical excellence and instructor quality. You will deliver NVIDIA training at the highest level, build the next generation of certified instructors, and help shape the agentic tools that will scale the NCI program and ALP network worldwide.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Train-the-Trainer Delivery: Develop train-the-trainer (TTT) programs to prepare ALP instructors to teach NVIDIA ILT courses. Ensure instructors develop both the technical depth and delivery skills needed to meet NCI standards.
* Refresher and Enablement Sessions: Run ongoing refresher training and technical enablement sessions for certified NCI instructors, keeping them current with the latest NVIDIA technologies, course updates, and delivery best practices.

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Risk Program Manager, Ops Supply Chain to join our Operations team in Santa Clara, CA. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will lead and develop NVIDIA’s supplier and supply chain cybersecurity risk program. You will continuously coordinate efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risk. Your work will protect NVIDIA intellectual property and critical invention data across our global network of suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics partners. If you’re forward-thinking, driven, and excited to protect one of the world’s most critical technology supply chains, this role is for you!

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own and mature NVIDIA’s supply chain cybersecurity risk program, leading the assessment and mitigation of cyber risk across suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics and distribution partners.
* Build and improve supplier risk assessment frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned to NIST (CSF 2.0 and SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management) and ISO (27001 and 28000) standards.
* Safeguard NVIDIA intellectual property and confidential technical data across the supplier ecosystem, defining controls for secure data exchange, need-to-know access, retention and destruction, and supervising supplier adherence to contractual security and confidentiality obligations.
* Support the supply chain CTPAT and counterfeit program, encompassing counterfeit prevention, taint avoidance, and scrap management, including detection, critical issue, and supplier remediation of counterfeit or tampered components.
* Develop and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber incident management for supply chain events to ensure continuity of critical suppliers, components, and operations.
* Translate supplier cyber risks into operational requirements and executive-ready reporting, dashboards, and metrics that demonstrate program posture and progress.
Advise senior leadership on emerging supply chain threats and program strategy, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to cross-functional partners.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* 12+ years of demonstrated experience in cybersecurity, information security, supply chain risk, or third-party/vendor risk management, including governance, risk assessments, and compliance.
* Deep knowledge of cybersecurity supply chain frameworks and standards, including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-161 (C-SCRM), and ISO 27001/28000.
* Proven experience leading supplier or third-party cybersecurity risk programs in a global, high-tech, or manufacturing environment.
* Hands-on experience with security incident management and business continuity or supply chain resilience planning.
* Experience protecting intellectual property and sensitive technical data in third-party environments, including data classification, access controls, and enforcement of confidentiality and security terms with suppliers.
* Familiarity with C-TPAT supply chain security requirements and counterfeit-part risk mitigation across hardware supply chains.
* Superb communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate supply chain cyber risks in business terms to technical and executive audiences.
* Proven ability to influence and drive alignment across multi-functional teams without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a technology, engineering, supply chain, or relevant scientific field required.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Certifications in one or more of the following areas: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CTPRP, or CBCP.
* Proficiency with GRC and third-party risk management platforms such as OneTrust, RSA Archer, ServiceNow, or BitSight.
* Familiarity with electronics manufacurting, ISO 22301 business continuity management and C-SCRM maturity modeling within contra.
Proven ability to build and maintain metrics dashboards for tracking supply chain and third-party risk programs.

San Jose, California, United States

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Onboarding Program Lead, Field Excellence owns the strategy, execution, continuous improvement and business impact of NetApp's sales new-hire onboarding program.

This role is responsible for continuing to transform sales new hire onboarding from a collection of assets into a structured, measurable journey that accelerates time-to-productivity and prepares new hires to perform successfully in the field.

**Drive Manager Accountability & New-Hire Readiness**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to join Amazon’s quickly growing advertising business, own strategic relationships with large publishers, and drive strategy and adoption of our industry-leading publisher solutions. In this role you will be a key leader within an entrepreneurial team tackling some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in digital advertising.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage product activation and overall customer experience for strategic streaming TV publishers.

  

* Employ a consultative, customer obsessed, and long-term approach to build productive relationships with publishers.

  

* Successfully launch new publisher products and features, share publisher feedback, and guide program strategy.

  

* Analyze publisher signals and performance data and provide data-driven insights to improve our advertising programs.

  

* Train publishers on program tools and provide strategic guidance to publishers on Amazon Ads solutions.

  

* Define processes and workflows that help deliver amazing customer experiences.

  

* Develop solutions to address key operational challenges, customer pain points, and sources of friction.

  

* Translate publisher feedback into product requirements and collect customer intelligence to help guide the overall direction of the program.

Amazon Publisher Services helps digital publishers around the world build and grow thriving businesses. We provide services and advanced technologies to web, mobile app and advanced TV publishers of all sizes, including many of comScore’s global top 100, to help them monetize their content with demand from multiple programmatic buyers. jobs.description:
**About Celero**
----------------

Celero Communications is building the next generation of intelligent optical connectivity for AI infrastructure.

Founded in 2024 by industry pioneers from Broadcom, Inphi, Marvell, and ClariPhy, Celero brings together decades of coherent DSP innovation with a focused mission to deliver the optical performance, power efficiency, and scalability required for tomorrow's AI-driven data centers.

We believe the future of AI infrastructure will be defined not only by speed, but by intelligence, energy efficiency, and the ability to seamlessly move massive amounts of data across increasingly complex networks.

Our mission is to build the technology foundation that makes this possible.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, with engineering teams in Canada and Argentina, Celero develops advanced coherent Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions that enable high-bandwidth, low-power optical connectivity for hyperscale AI infrastructure.

**About the job**
-----------------

Celero is seeking an organized, proactive Office Manager to run day-to-day operations at our San Jose office and shape the employee and visitor experience as we grow our coherent optical DSP ASIC business. You will be the go-to person for keeping the office running smoothly, a trusted partner to leadership, and a key contributor to a welcoming, well-organized workplace where our engineering and business teams can focus on designing, validating, shipping and selling coherent DSP silicon for AI data center and hyperscale optical connectivity. Day to day, you will host customer visits from hyperscalers and optical module makers, manage vendors and supplies, coordinate executive travel and meetings, build branded presentations and templates, process expenses and purchasing, and support onboarding, interview scheduling and events. **Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Office Environment:** Maintain a professional, welcoming office that reflects Celero's brand and culture. Keep shared spaces, labs-adjacent areas and meeting rooms organized and ready for teams and guests.

* **Executive Presentations and Templates:** Prepare executive presentations and create branded PowerPoint and Word templates. Keep company materials consistent, polished and easy for teams to reuse.
* **Expenses and Purchasing:** Process expense reports and manage office purchasing. Keep records accurate and timely and follow company approval practices.
* **Onboarding and Workspace Setup:** Assist with employee onboarding, workspace setup and the new hire experience. Make sure new engineers and staff have what they need from day one.
* **HR Process Support:** Support HR processes including interview scheduling and training coordination. Keep candidates, interviewers and trainers informed and organized.
* **Events and Culture:** Help plan and run trade shows, corporate events and team-building activities. Contribute to a positive, collaborative culture and support cross-functional administrative needs as the company scales.

**Basic Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree, or equivalent years of experience
* **Experience:** 4+ years of experience in office management or administrative roles
* **Microsoft Office Proficiency:** Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Excel and Word
* **Multi-Site Collaboration:** Experience working with international and multi-site teams
* **Organization and Detail:** Strong organizational skills and attention to detail across logistics, travel, expenses and scheduling
* **Prioritization:** Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

Experience with one or more of the following:

* Startup environment experience
* Semiconductor or tech company experience
* Hosting customer visits at a semiconductor, optical networking or data center technology company
* Working with multi-site teams in the U.S., Canada and Argentina
* HR experience, such as onboarding, interview scheduling or training coordination
* Planning trade shows and corporate events

**What Makes You Successful:**

* You are a self-starter who takes ownership without waiting to be asked
* You solve problems before they come up and bring structure where it is needed
* You stay calm and effective when priorities shift quickly
* You bring high emotional intelligence and a team-first mindset
* You are comfortable building processes in a startup with limited infrastructure
* You work well across functions and time zones with a global team
* You pay close attention to detail and follow through reliably

**Why Join Celero?**
--------------------

You will join a growing semiconductor start-up at an important stage and make a visible impact on how our San Jose office runs. You will gain exposure to operations, HR, executive support and corporate
