Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco — John N. Callander Administrative Office

San Francisco, CA | Monday–Friday, 40 hours/week| Full-time  
$72,384–$74,000 | Benefits Eligible

**Why This Role Matters**  
Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

**What You’ll Do**  
The HR Generalist serves as a key point of connection between employees and the Human Resources team at BGCSF. This role blends core HR generalist responsibilities with a meaningful emphasis on people analytics: building and maintaining the metrics, dashboards, and data infrastructure that help HR and organizational leaders make informed, mission-aligned decisions. The role also provides legal operational support to the Legal Department.

The ideal candidate brings an analytical mindset and genuine curiosity about people data, is comfortable working independently on open-ended problems, and looks for ways to improve processes and build for scale. They own the employee experience from onboarding through offboarding and design the systems and procedures that support it, set and maintain the standards for HRIS data accuracy and compliance, and partner across HR functions, including recruiting, training, and benefits, to support BGCSF’s mission and people.

**Records Management and New Hire Support**

* Design and own the coding and classification standards for HRIS data, deciding how employee records, job changes, and status events are categorized so entries feed accurate HR metrics and dashboards
* Manage all new hire administrative processes: Personnel Action Notice forms, change-of-employment and promotion letters, and data entry for new hires and transfers in Paylocity
* Provide a welcoming onboarding experience; prepare and process new hire and termination packets
* Conduct 30-day check-ins with new hires to assess integration , identify concerns, and determine next steps with managers
* Maintain HRIS (Paylocity) data accuracy: enter and code new hire data, update employee profiles, decide how nonstandard entries are classified, and follow up on Personnel Action changes
* Manage background check compliance: initiate, monitor, and follow up on screenings
* Maintain TB status verifications and personnel file integrity (disciplinary, performance, I-9, benefits, workers’ comp)
* Ensure employment records comply with all federal, state, and local regulations
* Manage uniform distribution and inventory

**People Analytics and HR Dashboards**  
This is a core function of the role. The HR Generalist will build and maintain data infrastructure to drive evidence-based HR decisions across the organization, and is expected to bring a point of view, not just pull reports.

* Design, build, and maintain HR dashboards tracking key workforce metrics: headcount, turnover, retention, time-to-fill, time-to-hire, absenteeism, and tenure distribution
* Generate and analyze reports from Paylocity on a regular cadence (weekly, monthly, quarterly); synthesize trends and surface insights for leadership decision-making, not just summaries
* Develop and maintain a People Metrics Scorecard aligned to BGCSF organizational goals; present findings to the HR Director and senior leadership
* Build and monitor dashboards for onboarding effectiveness: new hire retention at 30/60/90 days, orientation satisfaction, and ramp time; iterate on what’s being measured based on findings
* Maintain and analyze annual and pulse employee engagement survey data; synthesize results and recommend priorities to HR leadership
* Partner with Finance to provide accurate headcount and staff movement data for workforce planning and budget reconciliation
* Conduct regular audits of HRIS data integrity; identify and resolve discrepancies to ensure clean, reportable data
* Document data processes so workflows are repeatable and transferable as the organization grows
* Support ad hoc data pulls and analysis requests from HR team members and organizational leaders

**Employee Inquiries and General HR Administration**

* Serve as the primary responder to the HR inbox, independently resolving most employee and manager inquiries with timeliness and judgment; escalate unusual or high-risk matters to HR leadership or Legal and follow up to ensure resolution
* Handle leave of absence inquiries: evaluate each request against BGCSF policy and applicable leave laws, and coordinate next steps with HR leadership
* Process employment and wage verifications and reference checks
* Conduct audits of Social Security numbers, agency equipment, and performance review completion
* Maintain the supply of new hire packets, employee handbooks, and HR forms
* Maintain I-9 documentation and conduct regular audits; follow up on expired documents in Paylocity

* Assist with reconciliation of Ramp card transactions
* Support the annual HR process calendar: open enrollment, performance review cycles, and compliance training
* Build and maintain internal records systems (Google Drive, Paylocity, and other systems)

jobs.description:
**About Wing:**

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing's fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

**About the Role:**

Wing is looking for a **People Operations & People Compliance Lead**to join our People Team. This role is **hybrid** based in **Palo Alto, CA**. Our People Team is a small, nimble force with outsized impact across the organization. As Wing scales, we serve as a strategic partner for the business—helping build the culture, talent layer, organizational design and dynamic environment where exceptional talent can thrive, innovate, and propel our next chapter of growth.

**What You'll Do:**

* Strategic Leadership & Cross-Functional Governance
* + Own the multi-year roadmap and team-level results for People Operations and People Compliance.
  + Partner across the People Team and the business to proactively identify roadblocks and resolve complex workforce and regulatory dependencies.
  + Guide, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a culture of high accountability, psychological safety, adaptability, user-focus, and operational excellence.
* Employee Lifecycle & Scalable People Operations
* + Design and optimize a seamless, automated employee lifecycle experience.
  + Manage and scale global immigration and mobility operations (e.g., H-1B, TN, PERM/green card sponsorships).
  + Standardize cross-team operating procedures, self-service documentation on the Wing internal Portal, and escalation frameworks to resolve complex employee inquiries with empathy and precision.
* People Systems, Data Infrastructure & Automation
* + Drive the architecture, integration, and data integrity of Wing's People and Compliance tech stack, including Workday, ServiceNow, Air Maestro (aviation training/certification records), and internal data tables .
  + Leverage workforce analytics, dashboards, and automation tools to surface actionable insights for senior leadership, eliminate single points of failure, and continuously improve operational return on effort.
* Aviation & Employment Compliance
* + Oversee Wing's DOT/FAA Drug and Alcohol Testing Program, FCRA and FAA/DOT background check adjudications for safety-sensitive roles.
  + Lead statutory and federal/state compliance reporting and internal audits, including FAA regulatory audits, DOT/FAA Annual MIS reporting, EEO-1, California Pay Data Reporting, ERISA Form 5500, and multi-state/international labor law compliance.
  + Govern end-to-end extended workforce compliance.

**What You'll Need:**

* 12+ years of relevant experience in People Operations, People Compliance, Employment/Aviation Regulatory Compliance, or HR Systems & Operations plus 2+ years of people management experience.
* Proven experience scaling, operationalizing, or commercializing People Operations and Compliance programs in a high-growth technology, aviation, logistics, or heavily regulated operational environment.
* Deep domain expertise in U.S. federal, state, and local employment laws (FCRA, EEO-1, FLSA, ADA, leave/wage-and-hour laws) and regulated workforce compliance programs (such as DOT/FAA drug and alcohol testing, safety-sensitive credentialing, and background adjudications) .
* Hands-on systems and data proficiency across enterprise HRIS and compliance platforms (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, Air Maestro, ServiceNow) and advanced data analysis in Google Sheets / Excel (experience with SQL or workflow automation is a plus).
* Demonstrated executive presence and influence, with a track record of using data-driven storytelling to align leaders around pragmatic, long-term solutions keeping the user at the center.

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and it is Wing's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. Employment at Wing is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Wing does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

**GENERAL SUMMARY**

The Bay Club Operations Associate is an exciting opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas of Club operations while creating memorable experiences for members and guests every day. It's more than a support role; Associates contribute to the overall success of the Club by supporting hospitality, fitness, facility operations, and member services. This role provides a unique opportunity to explore different departments, build valuable skills, and discover potential career paths within the organization. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy variety, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are excited to develop new skills while building a foundation for future advancement. Bay Club Associates are expected to deliver outstanding service, uphold safety and cleanliness standards, support daily Club operations, and bring a positive, energetic, and professional attitude to every interaction.

  

**Our Culture**

Our unique culture is at the heart of all we do and is guided by our values and behaviors. It's what we expect of ourselves and each other every day. We call it our "Code of Culture".

Our Code of Culture includes Our Mantra, Our Actions We Live By, and Pete's Promise:

**Our Mantra:**

Respect The Past

Accept Responsibility

Pay it Forward

**Our Actions We Live By:**

**Actions We Live By**. It's who we are when we step into our full power.

**Keep It Real. Always.** We need open and honest discussions. We need courage to speak up and to call things out that aren't good enough. And we navigate tough conversations with empathy and grace.

**Think Ahead. Be An Owner**. Always be proactive, not reactive; be on the front foot. If we want to be an owner of this business, we must act like it!

**Stay Humble. Hustle Harder.** Show up and do the hard work. Be a gritty, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of crew. Know it's never about one person-we are a part of a powerful team.

**One Team. One Voice.** Be ONE united team. When we move in the same direction, there are no limits to what we can accomplish.

**Be Curious. Ask Why**. Stay member curious. We seek to understand, and we never settle. We ask questions to truly understand the core of a matter.

**Pete's Promise:**

Service Forward

Ruthlessly Consistent

Do the Right Thing

**Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.**

### **PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS**

### **Club Cleanliness & Housekeeping**

* Maintain cleanliness and appearance standards throughout assigned Club areas, including fitness spaces, locker rooms, lobby, reception desks, pool areas, restrooms, and common areas.
* Perform detail cleaning and preventive maintenance activities.
* Restock supplies, amenities, janitorial products, and inventory items.
* Assist with laundry operations, including collecting, washing, drying, and folding towels.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
* Identify and communicate maintenance and cleanliness issues requiring further attention.

### **Customer Service & Member Experience**

* Greet members and guests upon arrival and throughout the Club.
* Check members and guests into the Club and applicable activity areas.
* Ensure guest registration requirements and applicable fees are completed.
* Book appointments, programs, services, and class reservations.
* Provide information regarding Club amenities, programming, events, and services.
* Deliver exceptional service experiences to members, guests, and fellow Associates.
* Build positive relationships with members and guests through proactive engagement and responsiveness.
* Represent the Club professionally through image, communication, follow-through, and responsiveness.
* Assist in generating membership and program leads by identifying prospective member interest.

### **Reception & Operational Support**

* Answer and transfer incoming phone calls.
* Assist with property tours and membership sales as needed.
* Operate point-of-sale systems and cash registers.
* Process payments and member account charges.
* Complete opening and closing duties for assigned operational areas.
* Support Club events, programs, and special activities.
* Assist in operational coverage across departments as business needs require.

### **Fitness Operations**

* Provide general supervision of fitness and recovery areas.
* Ensure fitness and recovery spaces are clean, safe, organized, and operating according to Club policies and procedures.
* When appropriate, instruct members on the proper and safe use of fitness equipment.
* Monitor fitness floor conditions and report equipment issues or safety concerns.
* Ensure equipment, accessories, and recovery amenities are properly organized and maintained.
* Monitor music, televisions, and overall environmental conditions within fitness areas.
* Maintain exceptional member service standards within fitness facilities.
* Support fitness programs, events, and departmental initiatives as assigned.

### **Pool Deck & Hospitality Support (If Applicable)**

* Welcome members and guests to the pool and recreation areas.
* Assist with seating, amenities, and event support.
* Maintain refreshment stations and towel operations.
* Assist with setup, breakdown, and cleanliness of designated areas.

### **Communication & Teamwork**

* Communicate timely and effectively with managers, team members, and members.
* Follow up on assigned tasks and member requests.
* Participate actively in required meetings, events, trainings, and development opportunities.
* Collaborate across departments to ensure operational excellence and a seamless member experience.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

### **Other Job Functions**

* Work a flexible schedule that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Provide support across multiple departments based on Club operational needs and business demands.

jobs.description:
### **In Some Jobs You Take Orders. In This One, You Write History.**

Join the healthcare information technology team that’s turning drug and medical device data into knowledge used by thousands of hospitals, the majority of U.S. health plans, retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers, and millions of health care decision-makers throughout the world. Partnering with our information system developer and healthcare institution customers, you’ll help evolve leading-edge thinking into reality and make a measurable difference in improving human health.

We’re looking for people who are intelligent, productive, committed, willing and able to go above and beyond, passionate about making a difference, innovative and energized. You’ll play an essential role in a successful company’s continued growth.

**Are you ready for this exciting challenge?**

**First Databank (FDB)** is currently seeking a **Customer Support Lead** to join the **Customer Solutions team** . The Customer Support Lead plays a critical role in helping customers get timely answers, resolve issues, and make effective use of the solutions they rely on. FDB serves organizations across healthcare, including EHR vendors, pharmacies, hospitals, and pharmacy benefit managers.

The Lead handles customer inquiries and technical support through phone and email, takes ownership of cases through resolution, and coordinates with internal teams when additional expertise is needed. The Lead also supports the day-to-day effectiveness of the Customer Support team by helping colleagues resolve complex cases, monitoring queue health and service levels, conducting case quality reviews, and identifying opportunities to improve processes, documentation, and the customer experience. This is a hands-on lead role that provides subject matter guidance and peer coaching and serves as an escalation point.

In this role, you’ll track milestones, monitor KPIs, and be a go-to partner for program leaders and teams. This is a great fit for an organized, data-minded communicator who is interested in healthcare and wants to see how their work improves patient outcomes.

### **Primary Duties**

**Program Planning and Support**

* Serve as the point of contact for key stakeholders regarding program information and reporting needs

* 2+ yrs. experience in an administrative role
* Strong organizational skills with a focus on detail
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong Excel & Google Sheets skills; Familiarity with BI/reporting tools (Tableau, Snowflake, Power BI)

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.  
  
Aledade offers the following comprehensive total rewards package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:  
Base salary range: $24.52 – $34 USD an hour.  
  
The range above reflects the base pay we reasonably expect to offer for this role across all U.S. locations. Where an individual offer lands within the range depends on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and internal equity. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus/incentive and equity compensation in addition to the benefits listed below.  
  
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles  
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners  
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)  
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays  
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents  
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service  
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program  
401(k) with up to 4% match  
And much more!

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. jobs.title: Health Coach
jobs.description:
**Clinical Protocol Reviewer (Remote, Flexible, 1099)**

Hundred Health is a modern telehealth platform that helps people optimize their health through advanced diagnostics. Our proprietary technology generates a personalized wellness protocol from each member's results. Your job is to review each protocol, make sure it makes sense for that member, and support members in our Rx programs. This is a fully asynchronous role: no live patient visits or coaching sessions.

**What You'll Do**

* **Asynchronous protocol reviews:** Review system-generated protocols against each member's biomarker results, current medications and health history. Confirm or refine recommendations, and add brief personalized notes.
* **Medication awareness:** Spot where a member's medications may affect their lab results or interact with recommended supplements, and flag it for our clinical team
* **Recommend next steps:** Flag when follow-up or more lab testing would be valuable
* **Asynchronous messaging:** Respond in writing to member questions about their protocol and results
* **Rx program triage:** Help triage messages and requests from members in our prescription programs, routing clinical concerns to the right provider and flagging anything urgent
* **Close the loop:** Share member feedback and clinical insights with our internal team to improve protocols, content and product

**Who You Are**

* Deep working knowledge of lab and biomarker interpretation (metabolic, hormonal, cardiovascular, inflammatory and nutrient markers)
* A working understanding of common medications (e.g., hormone therapy, GLP-1s, thyroid, statins, metformin) and how they affect lab values. You won't diagnose or prescribe, but you know what to look for.
* Clinical or operational triage experience strongly preferred: you know when something can wait and when it needs a provider now
* Strong foundation in nutrition and evidence-based supplementation
* Clear, warm written communication
* Comfortable with technology and virtual care platforms
* Self-directed and reliable in a flexible, remote environment

**Backgrounds We Welcome**

We're open to a range of credentials and experience, including:

* Registered Nurses (RN)
* Registered Dietitians (RD/RDN) and credentialed nutritionists (CNS, CCN) with clinical experience
* Functional, integrative or lifestyle medicine practitioners with clinical experience
* Non-clinical individuals who have the same knowledge, understanding and training in hormone, metabolic health and nutrition

What matters most: you can confidently interpret comprehensive lab panels, understand how medications fit into the picture, and know when to escalate.

**Details**

* **Type:** 1099 independent contractor
* **Location:** Fully remote (U.S.-based)
* **Schedule:** Flexible and fully asynchronous

Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked in a fast-paced start-up enviorment?
* Provide a brief overview of your experience working with protocol development, clinical operations or healthcare in general as it relates to Hundred Health?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Hundred turns a member's health data (labs, medical records, biometrics and wearables) into a personalized, evidence-based 100-day action plan. We offer advanced lab testing, clinician-guided care and prescription programs in hormone health, metabolic health and longevity, all through one app. Hundred turns data into direction.

**The role**

You'll be the first hire on our Clinical Operations team, working directly with our Head of Clinical Operations. You'll own the day-to-day of our care operations: keeping prescription orders moving, solving pharmacy and lab issues, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks for our members. You'll also help us test new features, write our playbooks and automate what we do by hand. It's part clinical operations, part clinical product, and you'll help build the department from the ground up.

**What you'll do**

* Monitor prescription orders daily and resolve anything stuck, delayed or rejected before members notice
* Own issue triage with our pharmacy and lab partners: delays, backorders, substitutions and shipping problems
* Route clinical questions and escalations to the right provider and close the loop with members
* Support new pharmacy and partner program launches, from setup and testing through go-live
* Lead user acceptance testing for new app and EMR features, and write clear bug reports
* Triage supplement and marketplace order issues
* Write and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Find manual steps we can automate, and work with Engineering to ship them
* Pitch in on protocol review and member support during busy periods

**Your first 100 days**

* **Month 1:** Learn our systems and map the full care workflow, from order to delivery and from lab results to protocol
* **Month 2:** Set up our pharmacy and lab issue process, lead testing for a release, and write the first core SOPs
* **Month 3:** Run day-to-day operations on your own, deliver your first automations, and share your plan for the next six months

**What you bring**

* 2+ years in clinical operations at a health startup, telehealth or digital health company
* Hands-on experience with pharmacy and lab workflows (e-prescribing, compounding or specialty pharmacy a plus)
* Comfort with lots of tools at once: EMRs, admin dashboards, pharmacy portals, Jira and spreadsheets
* Strong follow-through. You close every loop and can prioritize a busy queue on your own.
* Clear, friendly written communication with clinicians, partners and members
* HIPAA training and good judgment with health information

**Nice to have**

* A clinical background (RN, LPN, MA, CPhT or similar)
* Experience with hormone, GLP-1, metabolic or longevity programs
* Experience in product operations or user acceptance testing
* Familiarity with LifeFile, Medplum and Clinical Intelligence Tools

Pay: $74,600.00 - $85,800.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

### **About the Role**

You’ll also work to automate and improve the reactive work that exists today, so that more of your time goes to proactive outreach and campaign development. Velocity is evolving quickly, and you’ll execute plays consistently while giving feedback that helps us improve them as the segment strategy evolves.

Spot patterns across accounts and turn them into improvements to the Velocity segment strategy. Stay aware of the competitive landscape and flag competitor threats you see in customer conversations.
* Use AI to scale your impact: Integrate AI tools and agents into your daily workflow, from account research and analysis to drafting outreach and automating routine tasks.

jobs.description:
**About MedeAnalytics**

MedeAnalytics is the Enterprise Healthcare Performance company that delivers AI-driven, cloud-native solutions to help payers, risk-bearing providers and other value- and risk-bearing entities measurably improve performance by reducing costs, improving quality and MLR, optimizing utilization, increasing reimbursement, and elevating care quality across all lines of business. Its enterprise health data management platform—built on its proprietary Health Fabric™—unifies clinical, claims, financial, and social data into a single, scalable source of truth that fuels insights, action, and AI.

As the industry's healthcare intelligence partner of choice for more than 30 years, MedeAnalytics combines its platform, cross-domain enterprise analytics, AI-powered workflows, and Strategic Advisory™ services to transform intelligence into accountable execution—delivering greater ROI across value-based care, risk and quality, cost and utilization management, and network optimization.

MedeAnalytics empowers organizations to move faster from insight to impact with confidence and measurable results. To learn more, visit **medeanalytics.com** and follow MedeAnalytics on **LinkedIn** and **Facebook**.

**About Our Opportunity**

The Business Analyst is a client-facing role that leads the implementation and ongoing use of cloud-based data and analytics solutions for MedeAnalytics healthcare payer and provider clients. This role combines business analysis, data integration, and analytics design to help clients use their data effectively. You will lead requirements gathering, translate business needs into technical and data requirements, guide client data onboarding, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver solutions that align with each client's business model. After go-live, you will continue to lead client support by responding to analytics questions, investigating data issues, and identifying practical improvements.

You will work closely with senior Business Analysts, Project Managers, Client Services, Product, Engineering, BI, and QA teams. You will contribute to process improvements, maintain clear documentation, and build the subject matter expertise needed to manage increasingly complex client needs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Engagement & Requirements**

* Act as the primary Business Analyst for client onboarding, production support, and analytics discussions.
* Lead client-facing and internal meetings to gather, clarify, and document business requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear functional, technical, and data requirements for delivery teams.
* Define and recommend metrics, dimensions, reports, and analytic outputs for payer or provider use cases.
* Build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders and communicate status, risks, and open questions.

**Data Integration & Technical Support**

* Guide clients through secure data ingestion using SFTP, REST APIs, and cloud storage such as AWS S3.
* Partner with Engineering and data teams to validate successful data landing, transformation, and processing in cloud platforms such as AWS, Snowflake, and Trino.
* Assist with reconciling datasets and documenting data lineage from source to target.
* Use SQL and basic Python scripts to support data validation, investigation, transformation, and repeatable analysis.
* Maintain accurate documentation of requirements, decisions, client-specific configurations, data flows, and test results.

**Analytics Design & Validation**

* Lead the design and validation of dimensional models, metrics, and OLAP cubes for healthcare analytics, including cost and utilization, risk adjustment, and quality.
* Lead business requirements, design input, and validation for dashboards and reports developed in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
* Perform data analysis to identify trends, validate results, and support client and internal decision-making.

**Post-Go-Live Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Respond to client inquiries promptly and communicate findings, next steps, and resolution status clearly.
* Investigate data and reporting issues, document findings, and coordinate resolution with Engineering, BI, Product, and QA teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting structures, metric definitions, and team processes.
* Lead or contribute to internal initiatives that improve onboarding, documentation, delivery consistency, and client experience.

**Essential Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in business analysis, client services, healthcare analytics, consulting, or a related role; SaaS experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of healthcare terminology and data, including claims, diagnosis and procedure codes, eligibility, provider, and transaction data.

**Overview**

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife — and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need better visibility into how work moves through our inboxes, how our teams perform, and how to deploy our workforce efficiently.

We're looking for a **Senior Operations Manager, Analytics & Workforce Planning** to build and own the analytical and workforce planning capabilities that power our Async Operations organization.

This person will design and establish the metrics, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that help us understand demand, throughput, productivity, service levels, and cost. You'll turn complex operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make better decisions every day.

You'll work closely with Async Operations leaders to identify what's driving SLA performance, where work is getting stuck, how much capacity we need, and where we can improve productivity or eliminate unnecessary work. You'll independently identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and influence decisions about staffing, workflows, and technology investments.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, and comfortable independently exploring complex datasets. They're excited to use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, build models, and solve operational problems. They can translate data into clear recommendations that help leaders make better staffing, workflow, and operational decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building analytical capabilities from the ground up and using data to drive operational change.

**The goal:** Deliver an excellent patient experience while continuously improving throughput, workforce efficiency, and cost per visit.

You won't just report on how the inbox is performing - you'll help us figure out how to make it perform better.

**What you'll do**

**Operational Analytics & Performance**

* Design and own the analytics and reporting framework for Async Operations, providing visibility into volume, throughput, turnaround times, backlogs, productivity, and SLAs.
* Build dashboards, reporting, and recurring analyses that help leaders understand operational performance and take action.
* Establish consistent definitions and measurement frameworks for key inbox metrics across teams and workflows.
* Analyze how work moves through the inbox, including incoming volume, completed work, aging, handoffs, and bottlenecks.

* Develop and own the analytical approach to understanding, monitoring, and improving SLA performance across inbox workflows.
* Identify whether SLA misses are driven by demand, staffing, productivity, routing, workflow design, or technology.

* Recommend and help prioritize operational interventions based on expected impact, feasibility, and resource requirements.

* Design and establish workforce forecasting and capacity planning models that translate expected work volumes into staffing requirements by team, workflow, skill, and time period.

* Advise Operations leadership on staffing requirements, workforce allocation, cross-training, and capacity shifts to protect SLAs while optimizing cost.

**Productivity & Cost Optimization**

* Develop and own the measurement frameworks for productivity, cost per completed action, and async cost per visit.
* Identify opportunities to increase throughput, reduce unnecessary work, and improve workforce efficiency.
* Analyze variation in productivity across teams, workflows, and work types to understand improvement opportunities.

* Strong data fluency and ability to independently explore complex datasets, understand data structures and relationships, validate analytical outputs, and draw reliable conclusions.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!

**Role Overview:**

As an Onboarding Specialist, you're the first person our new customers work with after they sign, and you set the tone for their entire experience with us. You'll lead live kickoff and training calls, provide guidance and support as customers work through their own account setup, and help ensure they feel confident and prepared to use the product by the time they go live.

Our onboarding process is primarily self-guided, meaning customers are responsible for completing their own setup, while you serve as a trusted resource to answer questions, provide direction, and help them navigate the process successfully.

This is a customer-focused, hands-on role on a growing onboarding team. Your work directly impacts how quickly customers become successful with our product and their long-term satisfaction and retention.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead Live Training.** Run kickoff and training calls that introduce new customers to the onboarding process, explain setup expectations, and demonstrate how to use the product in their day-to-day operations.
* **Support Customers Through Go-Live.** Serve as a resource throughout the customer-led onboarding process, providing guidance, answering questions, setting clear expectations, and helping customers stay on track toward a successful launch.
* **Assist with Launch Readiness.** Provide guidance on account configuration and complete light configuration tasks when needed to support a successful go-live, while ensuring customers remain responsible for their own account setup.
* **Follow Up Proactively.** Reach out to customers who are stalled or struggling, offer assistance when needed, and flag early signs of risk to your manager.
* **Improve the Process.** Keep onboarding records accurate and current, and share customer feedback and recurring friction points with the team so we can continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experienced**. You have 1–3 years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role.
* **Effective Communicator**. You're a confident, friendly communicator who can lead a live training call and make a non-technical person feel capable.
* **Customer-Focused**. You care about customers' outcomes, not just finishing the checklist. You want them to be using the product and getting value from it.
* **Organized and Dependable**. You can manage a full caseload of clinics at different stages without losing track of next steps or commitments.
* **Quick Learner**. You pick up new software quickly and can explain it simply, even when you're still learning it.
* **Self-Directed**. You're comfortable working remotely, taking feedback, and sharing what you learn with the team.

**Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have):**

* Hands-on experience in a medical practice or with EHR software (ChiroHD preferred)
* Experience using Customer Success tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero
* History of supporting small business customers directly
* Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
* Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity

**Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers):**

* Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
* Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
* Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time

**Why ChiroHD?**

**Impact & Growth:**

* Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
* PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
* Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
* High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
* Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.

* Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
* Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
* High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results
* Commitment to work-life balance and professional development

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

new_jobs.title: HR Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Position: **Human Resources Coordinator**  
Term: Full-time, hourly  
Pay: $30.00/hour + health insurance, paid time off, and other benefits  
Location: San Francisco, CA or Los Angeles, CA  
Reports To: Deputy Director, Human Resources  
Direct Reports: None  
Updated: November 3, 2026

**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION**  
Urban Alchemy hires individuals who were once incarcerated and trains them to transform people and places through love and respect. We provide services that heal communities challenged by the intersection of extreme poverty, mental illness, addiction, and homelessness. When individuals are suffering in our public spaces, Urban Alchemy offers solutions. When a neighborhood, street, or intersection earns a reputation as a place to avoid, we turn it around. Urban Alchemy staff, known as Practitioners, create a peaceful and supportive presence, helping our communities rebuild a sense of pride one person at a time. Urban Alchemy is a nonprofit organization founded in 2018. We quickly grew from a small program in San Francisco to a thriving social enterprise with over 1,000 staff. We currently operate in California, Alabama, Colorado, Georgia, New Mexico, and Oregon. Over 95% of Urban Alchemy employees, including leadership, experienced incarceration and/or homelessness. For more information visit our website.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Human Resources Coordinator plays a vital role in keeping our day-to-day HR operations running smoothly, accurately, and supportively. This position oversees core administrative workflows that touch every employee across Urban Alchemy: onboarding, I-9 compliance, background check reviews, employment verifications, wage garnishments, and child support withholding orders. Because these areas directly influence legal compliance and an employee's livelihood, the Coordinator ensures each process is completed thoroughly, accurately, and on schedule.

Success in this role relies on consistency, thoughtful organization, and dependable follow-through. We look for someone who manages their daily desk with structured care, keeping clear track of active requests, monitoring upcoming milestones, and seeing items through to completion.

Based in Urban Alchemy's San Francisco or Los Angeles offices and supporting all operational regions, the Coordinator works directly with Practitioners during the onboarding journey. Many of our team members are justice-impacted individuals who may be navigating digital platforms and online onboarding tools for the first time. This calls for genuine warmth, patience, and a helpful, welcoming approach. As one of the first touchpoints a Practitioner has with our HR team, the Coordinator sets an encouraging, positive tone for their experience with Urban Alchemy.

**POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

A Note on the Nature of This Work  
Even in a fast-paced, high-volume environment, the details matter. Timely compliance for garnishments and I-9s ensures our organization meets essential legal standards, while an accurate onboarding packet directly shapes a new hire's first paycheck and their first impression of our community.

The Coordinator manages their caseload with a clear, proactive approach: tracking open items, anticipating deadlines, and keeping communication open across teams. When questions or potential delays arise, they surface them early, document the process, and partner collaboratively to find solutions before timelines are impacted.

**Onboarding Administration**  

* Own the full onboarding workflow for all new hires across Urban Alchemy regions, from offer acceptance through completion of all required documentation
* Coordinate with new hire Practitioners to complete onboarding paperwork via Paycom, including assisting individuals who are new to email, smartphones, or digital platforms; this may include helping a new hire set up a personal email account from scratch so they can receive and complete their onboarding link
* Maintain onboarding accuracy and completion rates at a high standard; missing or incomplete documentation creates downstream compliance risk and payroll delays
* Communicate weekly with the training team to confirm which new hires have completed their onboarding documentation in Paycom and are cleared to attend the following week's New Employee Orientation (NEO), so trainers can prepare accordingly
* Communicate clearly and proactively with HR team members and Operations when onboarding issues arise
* Travel to other Urban Alchemy regions to support in-person onboarding when a new region is being established or when operationally required

**Pre-Employment Compliance: I-9 and Background Checks**  

* Manage I-9 form completion for all new hires in compliance with federal requirements, including timely completion, proper document review, and accurate recordkeeping
* Conduct regular audits of I-9 records to identify and remediate compliance gaps before they become violations
* Stay current on I-9 regulatory requirements and flag any changes that affect current processes
* Review background check results for all new hires, identify any disqualifying findings per Urban Alchemy policy, and escalate promptly so the appropriate HR leader can initiate the FCRA individualized assessment process
* Understand that background check review is not passive; the Coordinator is responsible for reading results carefully, recognizing what requires escalation, and moving quickly so the interactive process can begin without delay
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all background check outcomes and escalations

**Garnishment Processing**  

* Receive, review, and process all garnishment orders accurately and in compliance with applicable federal and state laws
* Process garnishment orders in Paycom using the garnishment feature, which applies the deduction directly to the employee's profile; the Coordinator is responsible for timely and accurate upload so deductions are applied correc

* Deep knowledge of cybersecurity supply chain frameworks and standards, including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-161 (C-SCRM), and ISO 27001/28000.
* Proven experience leading supplier or third-party cybersecurity risk programs in a global, high-tech, or manufacturing environment.
* Hands-on experience with security incident management and business continuity or supply chain resilience planning.

**Clinical Protocol Reviewer (Remote, Flexible, 1099)**

Hundred Health is a modern telehealth platform that helps people optimize their health through advanced diagnostics. Our proprietary technology generates a personalized wellness protocol from each member's results. Your job is to review each protocol, make sure it makes sense for that member, and support members in our Rx programs. This is a fully asynchronous role: no live patient visits or coaching sessions.

**What You'll Do**

* **Asynchronous protocol reviews:** Review system-generated protocols against each member's biomarker results, current medications and health history. Confirm or refine recommendations, and add brief personalized notes.
* **Medication awareness:** Spot where a member's medications may affect their lab results or interact with recommended supplements, and flag it for our clinical team
* **Recommend next steps:** Flag when follow-up or more lab testing would be valuable
* **Asynchronous messaging:** Respond in writing to member questions about their protocol and results
* **Rx program triage:** Help triage messages and requests from members in our prescription programs, routing clinical concerns to the right provider and flagging anything urgent
* **Close the loop:** Share member feedback and clinical insights with our internal team to improve protocols, content and product

**Who You Are**

* Deep working knowledge of lab and biomarker interpretation (metabolic, hormonal, cardiovascular, inflammatory and nutrient markers)
* A working understanding of common medications (e.g., hormone therapy, GLP-1s, thyroid, statins, metformin) and how they affect lab values. You won't diagnose or prescribe, but you know what to look for.
* Clinical or operational triage experience strongly preferred: you know when something can wait and when it needs a provider now
* Strong foundation in nutrition and evidence-based supplementation
* Clear, warm written communication
* Comfortable with technology and virtual care platforms
* Self-directed and reliable in a flexible, remote environment

**Backgrounds We Welcome**

We're open to a range of credentials and experience, including:

* Registered Nurses (RN)
* Registered Dietitians (RD/RDN) and credentialed nutritionists (CNS, CCN) with clinical experience
* Functional, integrative or lifestyle medicine practitioners with clinical experience
* Non-clinical individuals who have the same knowledge, understanding and training in hormone, metabolic health and nutrition

What matters most: you can confidently interpret comprehensive lab panels, understand how medications fit into the picture, and know when to escalate.

**Details**

* **Type:** 1099 independent contractor
* **Location:** Fully remote (U.S.-based)
* **Schedule:** Flexible and fully asynchronous

Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked in a fast-paced start-up enviorment?
* Provide a brief overview of your experience working with protocol development, clinical operations or healthcare in general as it relates to Hundred Health?

Hundred turns a member's health data (labs, medical records, biometrics and wearables) into a personalized, evidence-based 100-day action plan. We offer advanced lab testing, clinician-guided care and prescription programs in hormone health, metabolic health and longevity, all through one app. Hundred turns data into direction.

**The role**

You'll be the first hire on our Clinical Operations team, working directly with our Head of Clinical Operations. You'll own the day-to-day of our care operations: keeping prescription orders moving, solving pharmacy and lab issues, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks for our members. You'll also help us test new features, write our playbooks and automate what we do by hand. It's part clinical operations, part clinical product, and you'll help build the department from the ground up.

**What you'll do**

* Monitor prescription orders daily and resolve anything stuck, delayed or rejected before members notice
* Own issue triage with our pharmacy and lab partners: delays, backorders, substitutions and shipping problems
* Route clinical questions and escalations to the right provider and close the loop with members
* Support new pharmacy and partner program launches, from setup and testing through go-live
* Lead user acceptance testing for new app and EMR features, and write clear bug reports
* Triage supplement and marketplace order issues
* Write and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)

**Your first 100 days**

* **Month 1:** Learn our systems and map the full care workflow, from order to delivery and from lab results to protocol
* **Month 2:** Set up our pharmacy and lab issue process, lead testing for a release, and write the first core SOPs
* **Month 3:** Run day-to-day operations on your own, deliver your first automations, and share your plan for the next six months

**What you bring**

* 2+ years in clinical operations at a health startup, telehealth or digital health company
* Hands-on experience with pharmacy and lab workflows (e-prescribing, compounding or specialty pharmacy a plus)
* Comfort with lots of tools at once: EMRs, admin dashboards, pharmacy portals, Jira and spreadsheets

Reviewers grade workflow correctness, policy adherence, and stakeholder fit; flag operational risk; and document the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Senior Quality Lead specialist operations AI has to fit into an actual day at work. AuraOne uses experienced operators to grade outputs the way a senior peer would — checking workflow, policy, and the unwritten rules that decide whether a task actually gets done.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current senior quality lead specialist operations workflows, playbooks, and firm policy for Senior Quality Lead assignments.

* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published playbooks or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**

* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the policy or workflow being applied.
